Antwerp's rough buyers take note: De Beers now owns Gahcho Kué outright, after Mountain Province gave up its 49% stake to clear its debt.

Antwerpen: De Beers krijgt Gahcho Kué volledig in eigendom, nadat Mountain Province zijn belang van 49 procent afstaat om de schuld kwijt te schelden.

CEO: driven by "tariff-related uncertainty and the conflict in the Middle East."

Antwerp's watch trade will clock this: four Rolex Daytonas made £37.3 million at Phillips London, ten times what Rolex was first offered privately.

Antwerpen: vier unieke Rolex Daytona's brachten samen 37,3 miljoen pond op bij Phillips in Londen — tien keer het bedrag dat Rolex eerst privé werd geboden.

Phillips calls it "the largest single charity consignment ever sold."
